content: Telegram enforces two different text caps: plain text messages up to 4096 characters, but media captions (text sent WITH an attachment) are capped at 1024 characters for non-Premium accounts; Telegram Premium accounts get 4096 for captions too. This means a single character counter threshold cannot be correct for both the with-attachments and without-attachments cases, and the correct cap additionally depends on whether the connected userbot account is Premium - information the application does not have.
